The decommissioned husk of an '''Alliance Station''' existed in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Space station/Legends|space station]] resembled one of many used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="JTL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The debris resembling an Alliance appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
